findings.text: follow-on: after_suite runs at revision 64f77b335 (the intermediate commit that adds the inotify rename wait), not at the recorded head d153dd8c5 (the commit that adds the 120 s bound), so the population delta is not measured at the reviewed head; the manifest discloses this in follow_ons and a later d153dd8c5 archive refresh is excluded as it stopped at 71% without a summary, but a reader must reconcile the arm revision against the anchor commit.

follow-on: the negative-control arm base_supervisor_niced_20.log is revision 8a04f102f plus an env-gated taskset/renice stress hook applied to the supervisor, not a clean main run; the header line names the instrumentation and the old receipt wait is unchanged, and the base arm still failed 20/20 at the receipt assertion, so the reproduction holds, but the spec's plain '-n 8 beside a CPU-bound load' example is realised as a pin-and-renice shim rather than natural parallelism.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 8a04f102f; 77dfcd271 adds the opt-in scheduler-stress shim and the first event-wait attempt, 64f77b335 replaces pidfd_open (unavailable in the project interpreter, AttributeError) with an inotify watch on the atomic exit.json rename, and d153dd8c5 adds the single 120 s deadline and the path-and-directory refusal message; the whole diff is 37 insertions and 12 deletions in tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py.
item_verdicts.done_when: all four clauses hold: the receipt wait is named at tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py:1520-1522 (max(EXIT_RECORD_BOUND=10 s, launch_seconds * DRIVER_EXIT_SLACK=1.5)) in the instrumented base arm and shown failing 20/20 under contention; the head waits on the inotify rename event (COMPLETION_RECORD_BOUND=120 s, inotify_add_watch at line 1536) rather than a wall-clock window; the head passed 20/20 under the same contention (head_bounded_niced_20.log); and the negative control on 8a04f102f failed 20/20 (base_supervisor_niced_20.log).
item_verdicts.goal: the node makes test_dispatch_returns_when_its_supervisor_finished_the_launch hold under the parallel load that had it failing on 2026-10-04, by waiting on the completion event it asserts instead of a load-sensitive wall-clock window.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 77dfcd271 / 64f77b335 / d153dd8c5, changed_paths names tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py only, baseline_suite and after_suite are populated with real arms and a matching two-failure set, and the negative_control_log names base_supervisor_niced_20.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff against base 8a04f102f modifies exactly tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py, the one file in the manifest changed_paths; the declared figures directory and the declared evidence fragment are correctly left unwritten, as no figure was named and the node's evidence is its gate logs.

justifications.durability: the fix removes the load sensitivity at its source: the head waits on the atomic exit.json rename via inotify plus select inside one 120 s deadline, so the assertion is satisfied by the event it depends on rather than by a race against a wall-clock window, and on expiry it refuses naming the record path and the run directory; the real_timeout_refusal_probe.log fires that deadline path (missing exit.json refused after 0.054 s under a 0.05 s bound) so the failure guard is shown to work, not merely present; docked because the 120 s bound is a fixed constant rather than a figure measured on the host (the plan permits the event-wait alternative, so this is acceptable), and the env-gated stress shim is committed into the shared test file.
justifications.evidence: the base and head arms are real pytest runs whose headers name revision, tree and command, carrying EXIT codes and 20 affinity receipts each (base 20 failed / EXIT=1, head 20 passed / EXIT=0); the refusal probe shows the deadline refusing a genuinely missing record; and the population arms are real (-n 8, 1911 passed each) with an identical two-failure set. Docked because the after_suite population arm ran at 64f77b335 rather than the recorded head d153dd8c5, so the final commit's population effect is unmeasured, and the base negative-control arm is main plus an instrumentation shim rather than a clean main run.
justifications.fit: the change is scoped to exactly the case §12 names, test_dispatch_returns_when_its_supervisor_finished_the_launch, replaces only its wait mechanism and keeps the receipt assertion and surrounding semantics unchanged, and does not stray into the sibling test_a_discarded_run_is_not_recreated that §13 owns; docked one point because no evidence fragment was landed for the node although orientation_write_paths declared one, leaving the record to the coordinator's writeback.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every done-when clause is met and independently reproduced - the load-sensitive timing is named with file and line (tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py:1520-1522 base, max(10 s, launch_seconds * 1.5)) and shown failing 20/20 under contention; the head waits on the inotify rename event rather than a wall-clock window and passes 20/20 under the same contention; the negative control on 8a04f102f fails 20/20. Docked one point because the contention is a contrived taskset/renice pin on the supervisor rather than the plan's example of natural -n 8 parallelism beside CPU-bound load, which makes the reproduction stronger than but not identical to the recorded real-world failure.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff against base 8a04f102f touches exactly tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py, the single path in the manifest's changed_paths; the three commits carry conventional subjects and bodies with no AI trailer, the worktree is clean at d153dd8c5, and no figure, plan or shared index is written; docked one point because the env-gated taskset/renice stress hook is committed into the shared test file, adding measurement-only surface to a product test.
